title: Punctuation Practice
intro: Commas, quotes, colons and friends. Take it one mark at a time.
lines: Hello, world. Here we are, together.
Wait: is it two, or three? Maybe both.
Apples, pears, and plums; bread, butter, and jam.
It's a long road - or is it? (Not really.)
Numbers like 3/4, 5-6 and 7.8 are just text here.
Use a colon: like this; or a semicolon, like that.
Does it rain? Yes. Does it matter? Not today.
